nodes.title: TextEncode FRONT VIEW
widgets_values: Generate a full body front-facing character sheet view of this person. The character stands upright facing the camera, arms relaxed at their sides, on a clean white studio background. Maintain exact facial features, hair color and style, skin tone, eye color, clothing colors and style. Character sheet reference pose, front view, neutral expression, soft studio lighting.

nodes.title: TextEncode SIDE VIEW
widgets_values: Generate a full body right-side profile character sheet view of this person. The character stands upright facing to the right, arms relaxed at their sides, on a clean white studio background. Maintain exact facial features, hair color and style, skin tone, eye color, clothing colors and style. Character sheet reference pose, right profile view, neutral expression, soft studio lighting.

nodes.title: TextEncode BACK VIEW
widgets_values: Generate a full body back-facing character sheet view of this person. The character stands upright with their back to the camera, arms relaxed at their sides, on a clean white studio background. Show the exact hair style, clothing back details, same clothing colors. Character sheet reference pose, back view, soft studio lighting.

nodes.title: TextEncode 3/4 VIEW
widgets_values: Generate a full body three-quarter view character sheet of this person. The character stands at a 45 degree angle, facing slightly to the right, arms relaxed at their sides, on a clean white studio background. Maintain exact facial features, hair, skin tone, eye color, clothing. Character sheet reference pose, three-quarter view, neutral expression, soft studio lighting.

nodes.title: TextEncode FACE CLOSEUP
widgets_values: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of just the face of this person. Centered framing, neutral expression, eyes open, facing the camera directly. White studio background. Maintain exact skin tone, eye color, facial features, eyebrow shape, beard or no beard, hair. High detail facial reference, character sheet face closeup.

nodes.title: TextEncode EYES CLOSEUP
widgets_values: Generate an ultra close-up of just the eyes area of this person. Tightly framed on the eyes and eyebrows, white studio background. Maintain exact eye color, iris pattern, eyebrow shape, skin texture, eyelashes. Character sheet eyes detail reference.
